verdict.rationale: Docs confirm calendar autojoin (Google Meet) and an admin-facing 'Rules Engine' for controlling meeting access/privacy, suggesting some rule-based control over capture, but there is no concrete evidence of a per-meeting-type configuration UI (e.g., rules keyed to meeting title/type) or explicit Outlook calendar connection flow. missing for 10: explicit Google/Outlook calendar-connect walkthrough, granular per-meeting-type capture rule examples, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of this workflow.
